independent_outcomes: Admit interactive leaves (planner, signoff, act, publisher) to the resolved primary checkout directories they're instructed to read, with scoped resolution (post-brief admission vs. pre-brief known-targets fallback), excluding lane worktrees and unrelated directories, via the family's grounding flag
proposed_seams: If sign-off determines split is necessary: separate planner pre-brief fallback (decision 3, known-targets resolution when no bundle exists) from post-brief admission for signoff/act/publish/do_plan_batch (decisions 1–2, resolve-only variant of _admission_set). This seam is acknowledged in the brief's sign-off guidance and would place the role boundary in the type signature of the resolver functions.
